verdict.rationale: AutoGen is itself an official, first-party Python SDK (autogen-agentchat, autogen-ext) with pip install instructions, extensive documented APIs (AssistantAgent, teams, tools, memory, MCP integration) and code samples for building agentic applications directly against it. missing for 10: no independent third-party API stability audit or versioned API reference/changelog beyond migration guide, and no evidence of official SDKs in other languages besides Python.
